messages:
Irene: Quick sync  partner asked for a minimal 'refkit-lite' Terraform usage + on-prem notes: multi-arch image guidance (arm64 vs x86_64), OCI layout for marketplace, and a tiny smoke harness. Keep it copy-pasteable for SI teams.
Sam: Got it. I'll add a tiny module-usage snippet that shows nodeSelectors/tolerations for GPU vs CPU nodes and a multi-arch image example. We'll avoid full module source in the doc.
Diego: I'll own partner-facing checklist: artifact layout, immutable tags (digest pinning), expected outputs from the TF module, and packaging metadata keys for marketplace.
Nia: Security note: include KMS/HSM recommendations for on-prem (use customer-managed HSM or KMS proxy) and a short IAM example for a least-privileged service account. Also call out image registry allowlist.
Sam: Example Terraform module usage to paste in quickstart (module source + inputs only):
```
module "refkit_lite" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit-terraform//modules/refkit-lite?ref=v0.1.0"
  region = "us-west-2"
  refkit_vpc_id = "vpc-0a1b2c3d"
  kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd"
  node_labels = { "gpu" = "true" }
  tolerations = ["key=gpu:Exists:NoSchedule"]
}
output "refkit_endpoint" { value = module.refkit_lite.endpoint }
```
Sam: Multi-arch image guidance (short): publish both org/image:tag-amd64 and org/image:tag-arm64 and include digest pins in manifest.json. Prefer OCI manifest lists for marketplace packaging when possible.
Diego: Checklist (bullets): 1) artifact: container image(s) with digests, 2) manifest.json with model metadata, 3) terraform usage snippet + expected outputs, 4) smoke harness and pass criteria, 5) packaging metadata file (vendor contact, support url).
Nia: Minimal IAM sample for service account (short): Action: ["inference:Invoke"] Resource: ["arn:aws:redwood:*/model/*"] Condition: restrict by source VPC if possible. For on-prem KMS proxy, recommend mTLS between agent and proxy.
Sam: Tiny smoke harness (bash) to include in quickstart:
```
ENDPOINT=$(terraform output -raw refkit_endpoint)
resp=$(curl -s -X POST "${ENDPOINT}/v1/generate" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck","max_tokens":4}')
if echo "$resp" | grep -q "output"; then echo "smoke PASS"; else echo "smoke FAIL: $resp" >&2; exit 2; fi
```
Diego: I'll slot the partner-facing quickstart and checklist into the refkit repo README and add a short note about cross-arch testing in CI.
packaging-bot: Reminder: packaging window for the marketplace cycle opens 2026-05-10 00:00 UTC and final artifacts (images+manifest) must be submitted by 2026-05-24 23:59 UTC. Allowlist and digest pinning required.
Irene: Plan: Sam add TF + on-prem notes by EOD, Diego add checklist and README snippet by tomorrow noon, Nia add security bits. PRs to draft doc by Thu. Thanks everyone :memo:
